rules.description: Authorization policy belongs in OPA/Rego and the established OPA integration layer, not arbitrary C# policy or service classes.
rules.message: Authorization policy must be implemented in Infrastructure/Authorization OPA .rego/data.json artifacts. Read references/identity.md. Use an exact, justified allowlist entry only for an approved integration exception.

rules.description: New C# files must use a file-scoped namespace rather than a block namespace.
rules.message: New C# files must use a file-scoped namespace (`namespace Name;`). Do not introduce a block `namespace Name { }`. Existing brownfield files may keep block namespaces until they are converted.

rules.description: Count whole calendar days between LocalDate values with Period.DaysBetween.
rules.message: Count LocalDate spans with Period.DaysBetween(from, to). Do not copy Period.Between(..., PeriodUnits.Days).Days. Do not use (end - start).Days on LocalDate: that Period is years/months/days, so .Days is the leftover, not the span.

rules.description: Application C# uses Check.NotNull / Check.NotEmpty rather than ArgumentNullException.
rules.message: Use Check.NotNull / Check.NotEmpty instead of ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull or throw new ArgumentNullException. Generated clients and tests may keep BCL throws. Advisory only.

rules.description: AutoWire / DI types that only capture dependencies use a primary constructor with Check.NotNull field initializers.
rules.message: Capture dependencies with a primary constructor and Check.NotNull field initializers, not a classic constructor body. Extra constructor logic, base(...), and multiple overloads may keep a classic constructor. Advisory only.

rules.description: Prefer default core/decision when its axis is already correct. Shared non-default allow/deny belongs in one named *_decision, not per-endpoint rename wrappers.
rules.message: Prefer default core/decision when write-every on request ∪ resource (or read-some) is already the right axis; omit [OpaAuthorization]. Do not add a *-write.rego or per-endpoint allow_*/decision_* file that only restates default or renames a shared helper. Point remaining custom paths at one named *_decision (core/calendar_event_action_decision, core/property_bulk_decision). Keep a file per endpoint only when the decision body actually differs. Owner files are named *-action.rego or policy_bulk.rego.

rules.description: data-authz specs cover filtered GET/list payloads; write 403s belong in *-authz-spec.ts.
rules.message: Write-endpoint 403s belong in *-authz-spec.ts. *-data-authz-spec.ts covers filtered GET/list data. Advisory only.
